headline: Sensex rises over 600 points and Nifty tops 23,400 as crude oil prices ease

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Easing global crude oil prices lifted investor sentiment.
Return of foreign institutional funds supported equity buying.
Strong rally in pharma stocks extending gains for a third consecutive day.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 600 points and Nifty crossed the 23,400 mark.
India and New Zealand ratified a trade pact set to take effect on October 20.
Nearly 40% of Indian coal power plants are running critically low on fuel reserves.
Microsoft announced its 4th India cloud region in Hyderabad to expand AI infrastructure.
summary:
Indian equities saw strong buying momentum with the Sensex rising over 600 points and Nifty scaling above 23,400.
Cooling crude oil prices and foreign fund inflows boosted market sentiment despite West Asia tension concerns.
Pharma stocks led the gains, while Gokaldas Exports dropped following news of US Russia sanctions.
